info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the IT Service Request Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032/033/034). Drafts a catalog item with questions and a fulfilment target, updates it while DRAFT, publishes it, refuses a duplicate code whatever its case and an edit of a published item, then makes a request from it (a snapshot of the item, SLA pending), assigns, comments publicly and internally, starts fulfilment, fulfils with notes (the SLA is met), closes, reads the audit ledger in order, retires the item and shows the request untouched. A second folder proves self-service: a REQUESTER sees only the published catalog and files on their own behalf, sees only their own requests and no internal notes, cannot work a request, decide an approval or manage the catalog (403 ERR-SRQ-00403), and another requester or tenant gets a 404. Negative cases cover validation of answers and questions, illegal transitions (409), a retired item, tenant isolation and the absence of DELETE, with RFC 7807 error_code assertions. The approval path crosses into workflow-approval-service and is proven by the platform smoke (service-request-smoke). It files its own catalog under its own generated tenant id (srqOrganisationId), so it needs no organisationId from the Party Reference Data Directory.
info.name: IT Service Request Service - Catalog and Request Suite
